operating_domain: one local Windows NTFS host, trusted researcher SID/SYSTEM/admin and runtime; no hostile code under service SID
config_digest_policy: hash full effective immutable live config excluding its own digest and transient observed PID/epoch/results; approval binds config/source digests, config never hashes the approval document back
os_binding: PID + creation FILETIME via retained handle
own listener getsockname and child handle; not global process/port enumeration

trusted_bootstrap.approval_source: researcher-approved nonsecret artifact and ACL-protected execution record; ID/approved boolean alone grants nothing
trusted_bootstrap.issuer_location: trusted child entry after handles/source/OS verification

persistent_instance_id.creation: CSPRNG256 after exclusive fresh-root reservation; before keys/DB
persistent_instance_id.clones: same UUID with mismatched approved root/file IDs refused; same-SID/admin hostile clone beyond trust model
persistent_instance_id.restart: identity may persist; runtime epoch always fresh and new execution approval required

single_active.mechanism: Win32 CreateFileW shareMode=0, stable physical file, kept open; no path-only lock or PID-only lock
single_active.handoff: parent-to-owned-child explicit inherited handle allowlist; retain at least one live handle until child ready; close only own duplicates
single_active.abnormal_exit: OS releases owned handles; if parent survives it releases after child-exit evidence
single_active.limits: cooperating approved writer; malicious same-SID/old CLI/DB ACL bypass outside domain

session_contract.namespace: R16 connection object + authorization_id + epoch + canonical scope; enforce one Store/connection for lifecycle
session_contract.restart: old approvals invalid; no auto authorization recovery, no same-envelope rebind
session_contract.issuer_rebuild: shared process-lifecycle registry and R16 namespace; no new connection or epoch inside one live lifecycle
session_contract.cross_process_replay_claim: epoch-scoped invalidation under exclusive instance and trusted approval; no durable adversarial rollback resistance

recovery.key_DB_claim: file identity and trusted initialization provenance only; cryptographic content/key pairing remains unverified on recovery without separate permission
